snippet.title: Shards Of Solitude - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
In search of the supernatural, you find yourself in an abandoned factory, certain that you will once again return with nothing, but then you meet a mysterious girl named Miyuki, She's just lonely, so now you're staying here. With her. What happened at the factory? Who is Miyuki and how did she end up here? You must find a way out of the deadly situation she has created, or choose a different path.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4256690/Shards_Of_Solitude/

Voice Acting:  @erusha  
X: https://x.com/erushaVA
